abstract: Twenty children with primary mediastinal tumor underwent surgical treatment. Ten patients had benign tumor and the other patients were malignant. Seven of ten patients with malignant tumor were neurogenic, and 3 patients were of germ cell tumor. In the clinical manifestation, 11 patients were asymptomatic. All of benign tumors were resected completely, but in a few patients with malignant tumors, the complete resection not possible. However, except for one patient with immature teratoma, all patients with malignant tumor have been surviving following postoperative chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Two infants with bronchogenic cyst were operated on their respiratory distress syndrome in emergency, and have been salvaged.
abstract_ja: 原発性縦隔腫瘍の小児20例に外科的治療を施行した。良性腫瘍は10例、残りの10例は悪性であった。悪性の10例中7例は神経原性で、3例は胚細胞腫瘍であった。臨床像では11例が無症状であった。良性腫瘍はすべて完全切除されたが、一部の悪性腫瘍では完全切除が不可能であった。未熟奇形腫の1例を除き、悪性腫瘍の患者は全例、術後化学療法と放射線療法の後に生存している。呼吸窮迫症候群を呈した気管支原性嚢胞の乳児2例は、緊急手術により救命された。
